description:
Sturdy Frame: Constructed from high-carbon steel for exceptional sturdiness and long-lasting durability. The reinforced frame boosts impact resistance, making it ideal for gravel trails, mountain paths and everyday city commutes. It supports a maximum rider weight of 300 lbs and fits users ranging from 5’3” to 6’ tall.

Smooth 21-Speed Drivetrain: Built with a professional 21-speed drivetrain that delivers seamless gear shifts. Effortlessly tackle steep uphill climbs, flat paved roads and fast downhill descents, fully adapting to all types of terrain.

Shock-Absorbing Front Suspension Fork: This front fork efficiently absorbs shocks from bumps, potholes and rocky ground to drastically cut down arm fatigue during off-road rides. It balances steady handling and all-day comfort for a smoother cycling experience.

Dual Disc Brake System: Front and rear disc brakes deliver consistent, reliable stopping power in dry, rainy and muddy conditions. Unlike standard V-brakes, they eliminate brake fade for safer rides. Equipped with anti-skid tires, it ensures excellent grip even on uneven surfaces.

Ergonomic Design: Equipped with adjustable seats and non-slip handles, it can be adjusted according to the needs of riders of different heights. The bike arrives 90% pre-assembled, complete with all required tools and a detailed installation video for quick, hassle-free setup.
